install.script: install.sh#erlang (OTP 27 from ppa:rabbitmq/rabbitmq-erlang, rebar3 release binary)

kinds.label: Arduino – Uno sketch
kinds.notes: Output is the firmware, not the program's behaviour: graded by simulating it (Serial output after a set simulated time), not by comparing stdout.

kinds.label: C – Makefile project
kinds.notes: The Makefile's default target builds; `make run` runs and `make test` tests (TAP or plain text; exit code decides).

kinds.label: C – CMake project
kinds.notes: The program target is called `app` (the starters' convention); unit tests are registered with add_test (GoogleTest via gtest_discover_tests for C++).

kinds.label: C++ – Makefile project
kinds.notes: The Makefile's default target builds; `make run` runs and `make test` tests (TAP or plain text; exit code decides).

kinds.label: C++ – CMake project
kinds.notes: The program target is called `app` (the starters' convention); unit tests are registered with add_test (GoogleTest via gtest_discover_tests for C++).

kinds.label: Rust – Cargo project
kinds.notes: build.rs counts as a project script. cargo-nextest (junit) can replace `cargo test` once the image ships it.

kinds.label: Java – source files (no build tool)
kinds.notes: The main class comes from the entry's `package` line plus its file name.

kinds.label: Java – Gradle project
kinds.notes: A gradlew wrapper is ignored: the runner's pinned Gradle runs offline.

kinds.label: Kotlin – Gradle project
kinds.notes: Tier 3: the Kotlin Gradle plugin starts a compile daemon and many threads.

kinds.label: Python – project (requirements.txt / pyproject.toml)
kinds.notes: Packages come from the school wheelhouse only (PACKAGE_NOT_AVAILABLE otherwise).

kinds.label: Python – data analysis (pandas, numpy, matplotlib)
kinds.notes: Figures are saved (Agg backend) and returned as images.

kinds.label: Python – Flask API
kinds.notes: Tests (Flask test client) run in tier 2; the server needs tier 3.

kinds.label: JavaScript – npm project
kinds.notes: `npm test` must write JUnit XML to reports/junit.xml (node:test, Vitest and jest-junit all can; the starters do).

kinds.label: JavaScript – Vite app (React, Vue, Svelte)
kinds.notes: TMCode also bundles React apps itself (Live Preview); the runner builds and previews dist/.

kinds.label: JavaScript – Express / Fastify API
kinds.notes: Tests (supertest) run in tier 2; the server needs tier 3.

kinds.label: TypeScript – single file
kinds.notes: esbuild only strips types; an optional `tsc --noEmit` reports type errors as warnings.

kinds.label: Website (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
kinds.notes: TMCode's sandboxed Live Preview (signed token on the web).

kinds.label: React page (bundled in the browser)
kinds.notes: esbuild-wasm bundles the JSX in the browser (offline, also in exams).

kinds.label: Logic – truth tables
kinds.notes: TMCode's built-in truth-table view (logic/).

kinds.label: SQL – SQLite
kinds.notes: Graded with the result-set checker (tables, ordered or not), not text. T0 practice runs use sql.js in the browser.

kinds.label: SQL – PostgreSQL
kinds.notes: Tier 3: a PostgreSQL 16 sidecar per run (tmpfs, internal network), schema.sql + seed.sql loaded once into a template; every I/O test gets a fresh copy (CREATE DATABASE app TEMPLATE seed) and a NOSUPERUSER role.

kinds.label: SQL – MySQL
kinds.notes: Tier 3: a MySQL 8.4 sidecar per run (tmpfs, internal network); every I/O test gets a fresh `app` database with schema.sql + seed.sql replayed, owned by a non-root user.

kinds.label: C# – single file
kinds.notes: .NET 10 file-based `dotnet run app.cs`, or a pre-restored template csproj with Program.cs swapped in.

kinds.label: Zig – build.zig project
kinds.notes: build.zig must define `run` and `test` steps (zig init does).

kinds.label: Fortran – fpm project (test-drive)
kinds.notes: Dependencies must already be in the project (fpm fetches git dependencies, and boxes have no network).

kinds.label: Pascal – program (Free Pascal)
kinds.notes: Units in the project folder are found automatically; fpcunit tests are a later addition.

kinds.label: Assembly – x86-64 NASM (Linux, C library)
kinds.notes: x86-64 only (the runner's architecture). `global main`, System V calling convention.

kinds.label: Ada – main procedure (GNAT)
kinds.notes: The file name must match the main procedure (main.adb → procedure Main).

kinds.label: Objective-C – program (GNUstep Foundation)
kinds.notes: Flags follow `gnustep-config --objc-flags` on Ubuntu 24.04 (confirm when the image is built). NSLog writes to stderr; print answers with printf.

kinds.label: Clojure – deps.edn project (kaocha)
kinds.notes: deps.edn defines a :run alias (main namespace) and a :test alias that runs kaocha.

kinds.label: Visual Basic .NET – console project
kinds.notes: The project restores from the offline NuGet layer (no packages needed for a console app).

kinds.label: PowerShell – script
kinds.notes: PowerShell is a .NET program: T2 limits (threads, memory). Read input with [Console]::In.ReadLine(), never Read-Host.

kinds.label: GNU Octave – script
kinds.notes: Plots go to files (no display). `%!assert` blocks run with test(); a test step comes with MOxUnit.

kinds.label: Erlang – escript
kinds.notes: The file starts with a #! line (escript skips the first line) and exports main/1.

kinds.label: Gleam – project (gleeunit)
kinds.notes: gleam_stdlib and gleeunit come from the hex-school cache layer; Gleam has no single-file mode.

kinds.label: Common Lisp – script (SBCL)
kinds.notes: SBCL reserves its dynamic space up front: memory is limited with cgroups, never RLIMIT_AS.

kinds.label: Prolog – program (SWI-Prolog)
kinds.notes: The program defines main/0; plunit tests live in the same file (or a loaded one).

kinds.label: Verilog – simulation (Icarus Verilog)
kinds.notes: The testbench reads stdin with $fscanf(32'h8000_0000, …) and prints with $display.

kinds.label: VHDL – simulation (GHDL, VHDL-2008)
kinds.notes: The top entity has the entry file's name (main.vhd → entity main) and reads stdin through std.textio.
